d:
Elon Musk, the world's richest man spent nearly $446 million backing Republican candidates in the 2026 midterms. Texas alone accounted for roughly $224 million of his spending. He backed Ken Paxton's Senate bid and poured money into efforts against Democrat James Talarico.
But Paxton lost. So did several other Musk-backed candidates.
Now, with Democrats taking control of Congress, Musk could face scrutiny from lawmakers who have already called for greater accountability for tech billionaires.
